comp_req__gatewayd__starts_from_config.content:
On startup, gatewayd shall initialize the mw::com runtime from the
supplied service-instance manifest and, for each service type declared in
the SOME/IP configuration file, create a local bridge for every
``local_service_instances`` entry and a remote bridge for every
``remote_service_instances`` entry.

Integrity verification of the service-instance manifest is a property of
the mw::com runtime and is not performed by gatewayd itself; integrity
of the SOME/IP configuration file is covered by
:need:`aou_req__gatewayd__someip_config_integrity`.
comp_req__gatewayd__starts_from_config.title: gatewayd starts from runtime deployment configuration

comp_req__gib__connects_service_connecto.content:
When a configured service is offered on one side of the IPC connection, the
binding shall make it available to SOCom clients on the other side, and make
it unavailable when the service stops being offered.
comp_req__gib__connects_service_connecto.title: IPC binding connects service connectors across peers

comp_req__gib__forwards_event_payloads.content:
When an event is updated on a bridged SOCom server connector, the binding
shall deliver the same payload bytes to subscribed clients on the remote
peer.
comp_req__gib__forwards_event_payloads.title: IPC binding forwards event payloads across peers

comp_req__gib__propagates_subscriptions.content:
A subscription or unsubscription to a bridged SOCom event on one peer shall
be propagated to the corresponding server connector on the other peer.
comp_req__gib__propagates_subscriptions.title: IPC binding propagates event subscriptions

comp_req__socom__event_delivery.content:
When a SOCom client subscribes to an event, updates published by the
corresponding server connector shall be delivered to that client with the
published payload.
comp_req__socom__event_delivery.title: SOCom event delivery to subscribed clients

comp_req__socom__identity_and_version.content:
A SOCom client connector shall become available only for a server connector
with the requested service interface identifier and service instance. The
interface major version shall match, and the server minor version shall be
compatible with the client minor version.
comp_req__socom__identity_and_version.title: SOCom service identity and version compatibility

comp_req__tc8_conformance__evt_subscript.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that ``someipd`` delivers
NOTIFICATION messages (message type 0x02) with correct event ID
only to endpoints with an active eventgroup subscription, and ceases
delivery after StopSubscribeEventgroup.

Note: Traces to AUTOSAR SOME/IP Protocol Specification R24-11, section
4.2.4 (Notification Events), and AUTOSAR SOME/IP Service Discovery
Protocol Specification R24-11, section 5.1.3.1.1 (Subscribe
Eventgroup Entry).
comp_req__tc8_conformance__evt_subscript.title: TC8 Event Notification Subscription Lifecycle

comp_req__tc8_conformance__msg_error_cod.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that ``someipd`` returns
the correct SOME/IP return codes for error conditions:
``E_UNKNOWN_SERVICE`` (0x02) for requests to non-existent services,
``E_UNKNOWN_METHOD`` (0x03) for invalid method IDs, and
``E_WRONG_INTERFACE_VERSION`` for interface version mismatches.

Note: Traces to AUTOSAR SOME/IP Protocol Specification R24-11, section
4.1.2.8 (Return Code) and section 4.2.6.1 (Return Codes,
requirement PRS_SOMEIP_00191).
comp_req__tc8_conformance__msg_error_cod.title: TC8 SOME/IP Error Return Codes

comp_req__tc8_conformance__msg_resp_head.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that ``someipd`` returns
SOME/IP RESPONSE messages with correct protocol version (0x01),
message type (0x80), matching session ID, and matching client ID
for each received REQUEST.

Note: Traces to AUTOSAR SOME/IP Protocol Specification R24-11, sections
4.1.2.5 (Protocol Version), 4.1.2.7 (Message Type), and 4.1.2.4
(Request ID, Client ID / Session ID).
comp_req__tc8_conformance__msg_resp_head.title: TC8 SOME/IP Response Header Validation

comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_cyclic_tim.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that, in the main phase, two
consecutive OfferService messages of ``someipd`` are ``cyclic_offer_delay``
apart within the OA ParamToleranceTime.

Note: Traces to OA TC8 SOMEIPSRV_SD_BEHAVIOR_02.
comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_cyclic_tim.title: TC8 SD Cyclic Offer Timing

comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_endpoint_o.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that ``someipd`` includes
a valid IPv4EndpointOption in OfferService SD entries, carrying the
correct unicast address, port, and L4 protocol (UDP) so that clients
can reach the offered service.

Note: Traces to AUTOSAR SOME/IP Service Discovery Protocol
Specification R24-11, section 5.1.2.4.3 (IPv4 Endpoint Option).
comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_endpoint_o.title: TC8 SD IPv4 Endpoint Option Validation

comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_find_mcast.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that ``someipd`` answers a
FindService with a multicast OfferService, as defined by the OA tests
for a FindService received after half of ``cyclic_offer_delay`` and for
a FindService with the Unicast Flag cleared.

Note: Traces to OA TC8 SOMEIPSRV_SD_BEHAVIOR_03 and
SOMEIPSRV_SD_BEHAVIOR_04.
comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_find_mcast.title: TC8 SD Multicast Response to FindService

comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_find_respo.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that ``someipd`` responds to
a SOME/IP-SD FindService entry with a unicast OfferService for a
known service, and does not respond for an unknown service.

Note: Traces to AUTOSAR SOME/IP Service Discovery Protocol
Specification R24-11, section 5.1.4.2 (Server Answer Behavior).
comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_find_respo.title: TC8 SD FindService Response

comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_mcast_eg.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that ``someipd`` includes
a multicast IPv4EndpointOption in the SubscribeEventgroupAck for
eventgroups configured with a multicast address, so that clients
know which multicast group to join for event delivery.

Note: Traces to AUTOSAR SOME/IP Service Discovery Protocol
Specification R24-11, section 5.1.3.1.3 (Subscribe Eventgroup
Acknowledgement Entry, multicast endpoint option).
comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_mcast_eg.title: TC8 SD Multicast Eventgroup Option

comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_offer_form.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that ``someipd`` transmits
SOME/IP-SD OfferService entries on the configured multicast group
with correct service ID, instance ID, major/minor version, and TTL
fields upon startup. It shall also verify that the SD Session ID
increases with each message and restarts at 0x0001 after 0xFFFF.

Note: Traces to AUTOSAR SOME/IP Service Discovery Protocol
Specification R24-11, section 5.1.2.5.2 (Offer Service Entry).
comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_offer_form.title: TC8 SD Offer Entry Format Validation

comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_phases_tim.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that ``someipd`` doubles the
delay between offers in the Repetition Phase: the first gap is shorter
than half of ``cyclic_offer_delay`` and the second gap is twice
``repetitions_base_delay`` within the OA tolerance.

Note: Traces to OA TC8 SOMEIPSRV_SD_BEHAVIOR_01 (Repetition Phase
delay doubling). The offer count (``repetitions_max``), the initial
wait delay and the main phase transition are not defined by this OA
test and are out of scope.
comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_phases_tim.title: TC8 SD Initial Delay and Repetitions Phase

comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_reboot.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that ``someipd`` resets its
SD state upon restart: the reboot flag (SD flags byte bit 7) shall
be set in the first SD message after restart, and the SD session ID
shall reset to a low value (≤ 2). It shall also verify that
``someipd`` detects the reboot of a peer, shown by the reboot flag
set and a lower Session ID.

Note: Traces to AUTOSAR SOME/IP Service Discovery Protocol
Specification R24-11, section 5.1.2.2 (SOME/IP-SD Header, Reboot
Flag and Session ID handling).
comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_reboot.title: TC8 SD Reboot Detection

comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_sub_lifecy.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that ``someipd`` correctly
handles the SubscribeEventgroup lifecycle: acknowledge valid
subscriptions (SubscribeEventgroupAck), reject unknown eventgroups
(SubscribeEventgroupNack with TTL=0), honor StopSubscribeEventgroup
by ceasing notifications, and clean up expired subscriptions after
the subscription TTL elapses.

Note: Traces to AUTOSAR SOME/IP Service Discovery Protocol
Specification R24-11, sections 5.1.3.1.1 (Subscribe Eventgroup
Entry, including TTL), 5.1.3.1.2 (Stop Subscribe Eventgroup
Entry), 5.1.3.1.3 (Subscribe Eventgroup Acknowledgement), and
5.1.3.1.4 (Subscribe Eventgroup Negative Acknowledgement).
comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_sub_lifecy.title: TC8 SD Subscribe Eventgroup Lifecycle

comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_ttl_expiry.content:
The conformance test suite shall verify that event notifications cease to arrive
after the subscription TTL expires: when a tester subscribes with TTL = 3 and no
renewal is sent, no further SOME/IP notifications shall be received beyond 2 seconds
after the TTL expiry, conforming to OA TC8 SOMEIP_ETS_095.
comp_req__tc8_conformance__sd_ttl_expiry.title: TC8 SD Subscription TTL Expiry

dec_rec__component__someip_gw_registrati.context: The SOME/IP Gateway architecture separates the core communication stack from multiple gateway processes. This is necessary for safety separation (ASIL vs. QM) and to manage a single network socket, which can only be bound by one process. A mechanism is required for the gateway "client" processes to inform the central "server" stack of their routing needs at runtime.
dec_rec__component__someip_gw_registrati.decision: Gateway processes will dynamically register their communication requirements (service configuration and consumer event payload sizes) with the central SOME/IP Communication Stack process via the dedicated SomeipdService mw::com IPC interface.

sections: Architectural Design Decision: Dynamic Registration for SOME/IP Gateway

feat_req__tc8_conformance__conformance.content:
The SOME/IP Gateway project shall verify protocol conformance of its
SOME/IP stack (``someipd``) against OPEN Alliance TC8 SOME/IP test
specifications at the wire protocol level, without requiring application
processes.

**Scope boundary:** This document currently defines only the top-level
feature requirement and the initial set of TC8 component requirements
established for the test infrastructure split. The remaining component
requirements, covering method calls, field access, and the detailed
traceability matrix against the OA TC8 v3.0 Chapter 6 test catalog, are
added together with the test modules that implement and verify them.

real_arc_int_op__gatewayd_arch__local_sv.content:
- ``LocalServiceInstance::CreateAsyncLocalServices``: Starts asynchronous ``mw::com::GenericProxy`` discovery for a configured local service instance and instantiates ``LocalServiceInstance`` (stopping discovery) once the provider is found.
- ``LocalServiceInstance::Create``: Enables the ``socom`` server connector toward ``someipd`` and subscribes to configured ``GenericProxyEvent`` updates to frame, serialize, and forward application samples.
real_arc_int_op__gatewayd_arch__local_sv.title: CreateAsyncLocalServices and Create

real_arc_int_op__gatewayd_arch__remote_s.content:
- ``RemoteServiceInstance::CreateAsyncRemoteService``: Queries event type size and alignment from ``score_com_serializer``, creates the local ``mw::com::GenericSkeleton``, and delegates to ``RemoteServiceInstance::Create``.
- ``RemoteServiceInstance::Create``: Offers the ``mw::com::GenericSkeleton`` to local applications and registers a ``socom`` client connector that subscribes to remote SOME/IP events when ``on_service_state_change(Service_state::available)`` fires, strips the 16-byte header, and publishes deserialized LoLa samples.
real_arc_int_op__gatewayd_arch__remote_s.title: CreateAsyncRemoteService and Create

real_arc_int_op__gib_arch__add_svc_cfg.content: Transfers ``gatewayd``'s gateway configuration bytes and consumer event payload sizes to ``someipd`` for all-or-nothing creation of the corresponding bridged services.
real_arc_int_op__gib_arch__add_svc_cfg.title: AddServiceConfiguration

real_arc_int_op__gib_arch__create_client.content: Creates the client-side IPC binding for ``gatewayd``, sets up the configured bridged service bindings in the local ``socom`` runtime, and starts ``SomeipdService`` discovery to register ``gatewayd``'s configuration with ``someipd``.
real_arc_int_op__gib_arch__create_client.title: mw_com::create_client

real_arc_int_op__gib_arch__create_server.content: Creates the server-side IPC binding for ``someipd`` with the handler invoked when a ``gatewayd`` peer registers its configuration.
real_arc_int_op__gib_arch__create_server.title: mw_com::create_server

real_arc_int_op__gib_arch__is_connected.content: Returns ``true`` while the ``Someipd_service_proxy`` exists and ``someipd`` has accepted this ``gatewayd``'s ``AddServiceConfiguration`` call (see :ref:`someipd-service`), and returns to ``false`` when ``someipd`` stops.
real_arc_int_op__gib_arch__is_connected.title: Gateway_ipc_binding_client::is_connected

real_arc_int_op__gib_arch__start_server.content: Offers ``SomeipdService`` over ``mw::com`` so ``gatewayd`` peers can discover ``someipd`` and register their bridged services via ``AddServiceConfiguration`` (see :ref:`gatewayd-services`). Calling ``start()`` twice returns an error.
real_arc_int_op__gib_arch__start_server.title: Gateway_ipc_binding_server::start

real_arc_int_op__socom_design__alloc_pay.title: allocate_event_payload

real_arc_int_op__socom_design__call_meth.content: Allocates method-call request buffers and invokes asynchronous RPC methods (with optional reply handling or fire-and-forget).

real_arc_int_op__socom_design__make_serv.content: Creates and registers a ``Disabled_server_connector`` for a provided service interface and instance.
real_arc_int_op__socom_design__make_serv.title: make_server_connector

real_arc_int_op__socom_design__payload_s.content: Provides read-only and writable byte-span access to the contiguous message buffer, payload size adjustment after writing, and shared-memory slot handle lookup.

stkh_req__someip_gw__interoperability.content:
The SOME/IP Gateway shall ensure that its SOME/IP network interface
component conforms to the SOME/IP wire-level protocol specification,
enabling correct interoperation with SOME/IP-compliant devices.
stkh_req__someip_gw__interoperability.rationale: Automotive ECUs from different manufacturers communicate over SOME/IP. The SOME/IP Gateway network-facing component must conform to the SOME/IP wire-level protocol specification so that it interoperates with any compliant SOME/IP implementation.
stkh_req__someip_gw__interoperability.title: SOME/IP Wire-Level Protocol Interoperability

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.
